app.title: Vigía
nav.label: Sections
confirm.act: Vigía will delete messages and time people out on its own. Start moderating?
warn.jev-unavailable: Jev is not answering. Messages pass unmoderated until it's back.
warn.dropped: Chat is very busy: some highlight checks were skipped.
warn.halted: Vigía stopped because Jev rejected the API key. Set a new key and restart Vigía.
live.empty.title: Waiting for chat
live.empty.body: Messages appear here as Vigía reads them, with what each rule thought.
spoiler.noHighlight: Possible spoilers are never shown on stream
spoiler.topics: Protected topics (the streamer never sees these)
spoiler.topics.placeholder: One per line, for example: who the final boss is
spoiler.topics.none: No protected topics. Your mods can add some without you ever reading them.
spoiler.topics.count: {n} protected topics, added by your mods
screen.title: On stream now
kind.question: Question
uncertain.intro: Jev wasn't sure about these, so Vigía did nothing. Decide here, or adjust the rule's thresholds.
uncertain.empty.title: Nothing uncertain
uncertain.empty.body: Messages Jev is unsure about land here instead of being guessed.
highlights.intro.auto: Jev's picks go straight to the overlay. These are the ones it was less sure about.
highlights.intro.approve: Nothing reaches the overlay until a mod picks it here.
highlights.empty.title: No suggestions yet
highlights.empty.body: Questions and notable messages from chat will show up here.
rules.intro: Each rule is one yes-or-no question for Jev. Changes apply at once and are saved to vigia.yaml.
rules.preview.none: No recent messages to compare yet.
rules.preview: Of the last {n} messages, {act} would trigger it and {unsure} would go to Uncertain.
rules.preview.highlight: Of the last {n} messages, {act} would be highlighted and {unsure} suggested.
pack.antispoiler: Plot spoilers for the game on stream
test.label: Try a message
test.placeholder: Type what a viewer might write
add.title: New rule
add.help: Write the question in plain words. English works best, but Spanish works too.
add.question: Question
add.question.placeholder: Does the message tell the streamer how to play without being asked?
add.no.placeholder: Reactions, jokes, answers to the streamer
raw.title: Edit vigia.yaml directly
raw.help: For everything the forms don't cover. Invalid files are refused and nothing changes.
settings.mode.auto: Show them on stream right away
settings.mode.approve: Wait for a mod to approve
settings.includeBroadcaster: Also consider the streamer's own messages
settings.exempt.help: Their messages can still be highlighted.
settings.mode.local: Only this computer can open the dashboard.
settings.mode.exposed: The dashboard is on the internet. Mods sign in with Twitch.
settings.adminCode: The admin code is printed in Vigía's logs when it starts.
overlay.title: OBS overlay
overlay.help: In OBS, add a Browser source with this address. The background is transparent.
overlay.secret: Keep this address private: it contains the overlay key.
stats.costNote: Estimated at $0.042 per million input tokens. Output is free.
audit.title: Activity
wizard.language.title: Welcome to Vigía
wizard.language.body: Vigía reads your chat with Jev, moderates it with your rules, and puts the best messages on stream. First, languages.
wizard.rules.title: Choose what Vigía watches for
wizard.rules.body: You can change these any time, and add your own questions in Rules.
wizard.spoilers.title: Spoiler protection
wizard.spoilers.body: Vigía uses your Twitch category as the game. Telling it how far you are is optional: it only makes it stricter about what comes later.
wizard.spoilers.none: The anti-spoiler rule is off. You can add it later in Rules.
wizard.overlay.title: Add the overlay to OBS
wizard.overlay.body: Highlighted questions and announcements appear here. Use Preview to place it before going live.
wizard.overlay.mods: The streamer sets up the overlay from their own account.
wizard.observe.title: Vigía starts by observing
wizard.observe.body: For now it only shows what it would do: nothing is deleted and nobody is timed out.
wizard.observe.note: When the Live tab shows decisions you agree with, click the lantern at the top and choose Start moderating for real.
login.title: Sign in to the dashboard
login.twitchHelp: For the streamer and the channel's moderators. Vigía only checks who you are.
login.codeHelp: Printed in Vigía's logs when it starts.
login.stateError: The Twitch sign-in didn't match this browser. Try again.
login.twitchDenied: Twitch didn't complete the sign-in. Try again.
